QUOTE: "So "no vocab", "no tokenizer", "llama failed", and "empty input" all look the same to callers." and "so the API cannot distinguish failure from empty text"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says failure is indistinguishable from empty, but it also states that the speculative and MTP paths do check for empty tokens (`tokens.size() < 2`). That contradicts "no caller checks for it."
